_what_this_is: A SECOND calibration of the same physical card as eval/cells/BG-1/reference.json, taken hours later with the same driver and the same build. It is not the calibration anything is scored against -- reference.json is -- and it is kept because it is the evidence for a claim docs/EVAL.md and docs/STATUS.md make about the instrument.
_why_it_is_committed: Those documents state that per-cell noise floors move by up to 24x between sessions while achieved fractions hold to three significant figures. That is a measured claim, and for a while the only place its numbers existed in this repository was a test docstring -- which is prose. A published figure whose measurement is not in the tree cannot be checked by anybody, which is the one thing this repository is built not to do.
_conclusion: A floor is a spread statistic estimated from nine paired repeats and carries large uncertainty; an achieved fraction is a median and is robust. So whether a submission RESOLVES can depend on which session its validator calibrated in, and `burnish calibrate --merge` folds sessions together keeping the worst floor per cell.

device_probe._clocks_note: Clocks are not pinned and cannot be in a container. Only paired interleaved same-box deltas mean anything; absolute times from two different sessions are not comparable.
